text_block_list.text:
On this day, Manhattan Cafe invited me
to go mountain climbing, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...In the mountains...
it's easier to talk with my "friends"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...And so, there's something I want to say to my 'friends'—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Mmuh... I told you
to stop doing that...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Lately, my 'friend' has been pinching my tummy
out of nowhere..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...And while I'm in the middle of talking to people,
she'll come over and pinch my stomach......"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, hey,don't just run off ahead of me.........!"
Even after that, we continued the climb while she repeatedly had conversations with her "friend"...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"It's not good if your tummy stays squishy like this.
...It seems... that's what they wanted to say..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... If it keeps me from getting pinched,
I think I'll keep up... the mountain climbing for a while...

It seemed they managed to make up. Manhattan Cafe,
who took up mountain climbing starting that day,
successfully managed to lose weight.
